description: Sets or removes your own profile photo. Give an https image_url or a small image_base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at least 120 px), or clear:true to remove it. The server re-encodes the picture to a square WebP and removes its metadata. The photo link is public. Call without confirm first for a preview with the image size.

clear.description: Remove the current photo instead of uploading.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

image_base64.description: Small image as base64 (about 180 KB at most); use image_url for anything larger.

image_url.description: https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (max 5 MB, 120-6000 px). Fetched by the server.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: profile_avatar_set
title: Set or remove my photo
